narrative: Today's briefing highlights significant advancements in AI, with new voice models and agentic systems, alongside critical infrastructure developments in cloud computing and network services. Space exploration and new technology products also feature prominently, offering insights into the evolving tech landscape.

highlights.title: Fish Audio raises $50M seed to build AI voice models for creators and enterprises
highlights.whyItMatters: The startup has gained significant traction with over 8 million users and substantial annual recurring revenue, indicating strong demand for AI voice models.

highlights.title: Apple launches ‘Upgrade’ device leasing program in partnership with Klarna
highlights.whyItMatters: This new leasing program makes Apple devices more accessible, potentially expanding their market reach and changing consumer purchasing habits.

highlights.title: Perplexity’s Personal Computer turns Windows PCs into AI agents
highlights.whyItMatters: Perplexity's expansion to Windows signifies a major step towards making AI agents a standard feature on personal computers, enhancing local AI capabilities.

highlights.title: 7.1 Earthquake in Japan
highlights.whyItMatters: A powerful earthquake in Japan highlights ongoing seismic activity and the need for resilient infrastructure and disaster preparedness.

highlights.title: NVIDIA Open Sources First GPU-Accelerated Medical Physics Simulation Framework
highlights.whyItMatters: This open-source release by NVIDIA will likely accelerate research and development in medical robotics and healthcare simulations.

highlights.title: OpenAI and Broadcom unveil LLM-optimized inference chip
highlights.whyItMatters: The introduction of 'Jalapeño' aims to significantly boost the performance and efficiency of large language model inference across AI systems.

highlights.title: AWS Lambda introduces MicroVMs
highlights.whyItMatters: MicroVMs in AWS Lambda offer enhanced isolation and control for serverless applications, promising faster iteration and improved security.

highlights.title: Cloudflare Internal DNS is now generally available
highlights.whyItMatters: Expanding Cloudflare's robust DNS services to private networks enhances security and control for internal infrastructure, leveraging existing global network capabilities.
